newsitem.title: USA: Alternative Resources off on projections.
newsitem.headline: Alternative Resources off on projections.

text.p: Shares of Alternative Resources Corp fell 1-3/8 to 15-3/8 Wednesday after the company released 1996 fourth quarter earnings projections which disappointed analysts.

Late Tuesday, Alternative Resources, which provides technical staffing for information services, said it expects to report earnings of $0.22 to $0.24 a share, versus $0.21 a share last year. According to First Call, the range of analysts' estimates was $0.23 to $0.25 a share, with a consensus of $0.24 a share.
"They pre-released their earnings and identified a slightly below consensus earnings number," said one analyst, who asked not to be identified.
The company also said it will report lower margins related mainly to its large national accounts.
But analyst Perry Boyle of Alex. Brown said he continues to rate the stock a buy and sees it as a bargain at these price levels.

"There are some margin pressures from some large customers, but otherwise margins appear to be holding up well at the company," he said, adding he is expecting earnings growth to pick up in the second half of 1997.
"At these price levels we have a buy rating on the stock and see it as a value play in the staffing industry," he said.
